build_coco_dataset: build a python module to create a CocoDetection dataset from a COCO annotation JSON file
create_cached_coco_dataset: create a CocoDetection dataset with cache_mode enabled to cache images in memory for faster access
test_getitem: test the CocoDetection __getitem__ method to return an image and its annotations by index
review_cache_images: review the CocoDetection cache_images method that loads images into memory with distributed rank support
summarize_get_image: summarize the CocoDetection get_image method that returns a PIL image from cache or disk
